memories.text: Spare front-door key is in the blue biscuit tin at Mom's.
Buy a plunger before needing a plunger.
Grandma's rice pudding: whole milk, one cinnamon stick, patience. She never measured the sugar.
The dentist said to bring the old mouth guard next time. Appointment card is tucked into the calendar.
Comprar pilas para la linterna y devolver el paraguas de mi hermana.
After work I walked the long way home. The extra twenty minutes helped untangle my mood.
First tomato seedling appeared today. Absurdly proud of two tiny leaves.
Camping list: matches in a dry jar, thick socks, tea, something to sit on.
The mystery novel was excellent until the secret twin appeared. Remember this before borrowing the sequel.
Papá encontró la foto del picnic. Todos miramos a la cámara menos el perro.
Kitchen tap drips only when the handle rests halfway. Take a photo of the fitting before buying parts.
Pack a proper lunch for work tomorrow: lentil salad, apple, handful of almonds.
Transferred $25 into the emergency fund. Small counts.
Train trip reminder: the cheap ticket did not include a seat reservation. Standing for two hours taught me to read the details.
La sopa quedó mejor con limón al final. No hace falta añadir más sal.
My friend brought oranges instead of flowers when I was sick. I want to remember that kind of practical kindness.
Keep the birthday cards with handwritten messages. Recycle the envelopes.
Work ran late, but I still made it to the pool for fifteen minutes. A short swim counts.
Old address book correction: my aunt's apartment number ends in 6, not 8.
Revisar la presión de las ruedas antes del viaje del sábado.
The wool sweater needs cold water and a flat drying spot. The smaller sweater is evidence.
Eye appointment booked for the 19th. Ask why the new lenses feel strange on stairs.
Started a jar for loose change. Goal: a train ticket somewhere new.
A difficult conversation at work felt less frightening once I wrote down the actual question.
Mi sobrino dice que la luna nos sigue porque quiere venir a cenar.
Bread recipe from the folded newspaper clipping: let the dough rest before adding more flour. Sticky does not always mean wrong.
Need library returns, dish soap, stamps, and a replacement bike light.
The little museum near the station has free admission on the first Sunday. Allow more than half an hour.
Found the missing earring inside the winter boot. No theory explains this.
Después del trabajo fui al cine sin mirar antes las críticas. Me gustó llegar sin expectativas.
My knees felt fine on the flat route. Try that walk again before attempting the steep trail.
Gift idea for Dad: sharpen his kitchen knives and cook dinner together.
A sentence from my old notebook: "Leave room for the day to surprise you."
Put the holiday lights around cardboard before storing them. Future me deserves one easy task.
La cremallera de la mochila se atasca en la esquina. Llevarla a arreglar antes de que se rompa.
Forgot to eat breakfast before work and became irrationally angry at a stapler. Keep oats ready.
Booked the annual checkup. Bring the list of questions instead of assuming I will remember them.
The bathroom window sticks after rain. Check the paint buildup when it dries.
My sister and I spent an entire afternoon sorting photographs. We disagreed about dates and agreed about keeping every blurry one of Grandma.
Probar garbanzos tostados con pimentón. Secarlos bien primero.
From the old travel notebook: the quietest room faced the courtyard, but the bells started at seven.
Turned off work notifications for dinner. Nothing collapsed, and I actually tasted the food.
Borrow a drill for the shelf. Check the wall before choosing anchors.
The library book with the green cover has the useful chapter on pruning. Photograph the title next time.
Hoy nadé ocho largos sin parar. Fui despacio y salí contento.
Set aside cash for the autumn train fare before browsing for new shoes.
First attempt at watercolor clouds looked like potatoes. Keep it anyway.
Tomorrow's work task feels huge. Start by opening the document and writing three plain sentences.
My friend likes birthday breakfasts more than birthday parties. Pancakes next year.
Guardar una copia del itinerario en papel. El teléfono se quedó sin batería justo al llegar.
The rosemary survived the cold snap. Move the pot away from the draft anyway.
Old sewing note: measure the curtains after washing the fabric, not before.
Renew the library card and ask whether the old fines are still on it.
Work was noisy today. Ten quiet minutes with tea felt like finding an empty room inside my head.
La abuela quiere que le imprima las fotos. No le sirve que estén en un enlace.
The soup freezes well without the noodles. Add fresh noodles when reheating.
Ask the pharmacist whether this refill can be collected a few days early before the trip.
My cousin taught me three guitar chords. My fingertips object; the rest of me is delighted.
Replace the smoke alarm battery. The spare is in the drawer with the tape measure.
Llevar zapatos cómodos mañana. Después del trabajo quiero caminar hasta la biblioteca.
The cheapest flight becomes less cheap after luggage and the airport bus. Compare the full total.
Bought a secondhand chess set missing one pawn. A button serves admirably.
Dinner for six needs fewer dishes than I imagine. One big pot, bread, salad, something sweet.
Copied from an old pocket diary: Dad laughed so hard during the card game that he had to take off his glasses.
La bicicleta hace un clic al subir cuestas. Pedir que revisen la cadena.
Finished the work task I had been avoiding. It took forty minutes; the dread took three days.
Put the spare duvet on the guest bed before my sister arrives. Check the bedside lamp too.
I want a winter ritual that costs almost nothing: Saturday soup and a borrowed film.
Dentist at 9:20 next Thursday. Leave extra time for the bus.
No comprar otra libreta hasta llenar al menos una de las que ya tengo.
The hallway bulb is a small screw fitting. Take the dead one to the shop.
Bring headphones for the journey to work. Download the audiobook tonight.
My friend remembered the anniversary without being reminded. That mattered more than I managed to say.
Tried growing radishes. Apparently I can produce leaves with exceptional confidence.
La tarta necesita diez minutos más en mi horno. Cubrirla si se dora demasiado.
Check the bank statement for the duplicate ticket charge. Keep both receipts until it is sorted.
The beach was better at low tide. Next trip, check the tide table before choosing a picnic spot.
Said no to an extra task at work without writing a paragraph of apology. Practicing.
My nephew has started calling every bird a duck. Correct taxonomy can wait.
Pedir cita para revisar la vista. Estoy alejando demasiado el libro.
Recipe experiment: roasted carrots, yogurt, cumin, toasted seeds. Worth repeating with less cumin.
The small suitcase wheel can be replaced. Measure the axle before ordering anything.
Reading idea: one novel from each country I have visited. Borrow before buying.
Work spilled into my thoughts all evening. Writing tomorrow's first step on paper finally let me put it down.
Este año quiero regalar cosas que se usen: aceite bueno, calcetines, entradas, tiempo.
The upstairs radiator makes a knocking sound around dawn. Record it for the plumber.
Took Mom to the garden center. We bought one plant and discussed forty.
Keep a small snack in the walking bag. Hunger makes every hill look personal.
The poetry collection is best read one page at a time. No need to finish it like a race.
Después del trabajo compré flores para la mesa. La cocina parece otra con algo amarillo.
Passport expires sooner than I thought. Check renewal requirements this weekend.
Lunch idea: leftover potatoes crisped in a pan, egg on top, hot sauce.
My friend offered to teach me to knit. Bring light-colored yarn so I can see what I am doing.
Moved the insurance renewal date into the calendar with a reminder two weeks earlier.
El paseo junto al río tiene sombra por la mañana. Buena opción para llevar a papá.
Had a good idea for work while washing dishes. Keep a pencil nearby; wet hands and phones are a bad combination.
Three things to mend: loose coat button, torn shopping bag, cushion seam.
The hotel kettle was tiny, but tea overlooking the harbor felt extravagant.
Book a hearing check if the ringing continues. Note when it happens and how long it lasts.
Encontré la receta de mi tía detrás de una foto. Tiene una mancha de chocolate justo sobre la cantidad de harina.
A useful sentence for myself: "You can change the plan without calling the day a failure."
Put the work notebook away before the holiday meal. The table needs room for plates and elbows.
The bedside clock is seven minutes fast. This is no longer helping anyone.
Bought frozen berries instead of fresh ones. Better for porridge, cheaper, less guilt in the fruit drawer.
Reservar mesa para el cumpleaños de mamá. Prefiere un sitio tranquilo donde podamos hablar.
The physiotherapist suggested keeping track of what makes the shoulder ache. Start with carrying the heavy bag.
My brother sent a recording of the rain on his roof. An unexpectedly lovely message.
Work deadline Friday. Freeze two portions of tonight's dinner so Thursday needs less thinking.
Try sketching the same tree once a month. Changes will be easier to see together.
La puerta del armario roza abajo. Revisar primero las bisagras.
The overnight train needs an eye mask, earplugs, and realistic expectations about sleep.
Cancel the magazine subscription before the renewal. I like the idea of reading it more than I actually read it.
Made jam with my aunt. She put a saucer in the freezer to test the set. I mostly washed jars. The kitchen smelled wonderful.
A kind message about my work arrived on a day when I needed it. Save it somewhere easy to find.
Devolver el libro de recetas y pedir prestado el de aves del barrio.
Check whether the winter boots can be resoled. The uppers still have years left.
My niece beat me at the memory game three times. I was trying.
Evening headaches seem more common after long stretches without water. Mention the pattern at the appointment.
Holiday packing: charger, warm socks, spare glasses, the cake tin Mom wants back.
Preparar la comida antes de acostarme facilita mucho las mañanas de trabajo.
Found a small leak under the sink. Put a bowl beneath it and arranged a plumber for tomorrow.
The biography made me want to read the letters it quoted. Look for a collected edition.
My friend and I are trying a monthly walk instead of repeatedly saying we should meet.
Budget note: annual expenses still count when they are not due this month.
Las lentejas quedaron mejor al día siguiente. Guardar una porción antes de servir.
Took a real lunch break during work today. Read six pages and returned less scattered.
The climbing class was mostly learning to fall safely. More reassuring than glamorous.
Ask Dad to label the people in the old wedding photograph while he still remembers the names.
Bring a reusable cup to the early train. The lid on the last paper one leaked into my sleeve.
El gato de mi hermana solo se deja cepillar junto a la ventana. Llevar el cepillo allí.
New running shoes felt good for the first mile and rubbed after three. Keep the receipt.
Need to stop rehearsing work conversations while brushing my teeth. Tonight I counted the tiles instead.
The curtain rod needs a center bracket. Measure the gap and photograph the existing supports.
A birthday tradition worth keeping: ask everyone for one good thing from the past year.
Idea para un cuento: una persona recibe postales de un viaje que todavía no ha hecho.
Roasted the vegetables on two trays instead of crowding one. Finally understood the difference between roasted and steamed.
Replace the worn rubber feet on the kitchen chair before they scratch another line in the floor.
Work has felt repetitive lately. Learning one new guitar chord in the evening gives the day a different ending.
The dentist moved the appointment to 11:40. Update the paper calendar too.
Llamar a la abuela después de comer. Por la tarde suele tener el teléfono lejos.
Inventory before shopping: plenty of rice, no onions, mysterious abundance of mustard.
Started photographing the same view from the window each morning. Today the light was almost silver.
My friend left homemade bread at the door. We waved through the glass for longer than necessary.
Wrote down a stopping time for work and actually kept it. Cooked slowly afterward.
He terminado la novela larga. Echo de menos a los personajes como si se hubieran mudado.
The basil cuttings rooted in water. Move them into pots before the roots become a tangled beard.
Check the refund status for the canceled tickets. Confirmation email is saved with the booking receipt.
Made a list of questions before the phone appointment. Much easier than trying to remember while nervous.
Idea: exchange handwritten recipes with friends, including the stains and crossed-out bits.
Un asunto del trabajo me tenía dando vueltas. Salir a caminar no lo resolvió, pero me ayudó a respirar.
The loose tile near the bath needs attention before water gets underneath. Take measurements this weekend.
My nephew read me a whole page over the phone. I could hear him smiling when he finished.
This year's best purchase might be the warm blanket. No batteries, no learning curve.
Sort the medicine drawer by expiry date. Ask the pharmacy how to dispose of the old packets.
Hacer una copia de las fotos antes de cambiar de teléfono.
Keep a spare snack in the bag for long work days. The emergency crackers have become a permanent institution.
My sister wants the yellow mixing bowl if I ever get rid of it. Apparently childhood has a specific bowl.
The bank fee disappeared after I asked about it. Check statements instead of assuming every charge belongs.
First bike ride in months: short route, soft rain, enormous appetite afterward.
El arroz al horno necesita menos caldo en esta fuente. Anotarlo en la receta de una vez.
Borrowed a book about local trees. Now every walk includes stopping to argue with a leaf.
Work meeting tomorrow. Write the main point at the top of the page so I do not bury it under context.
The washing machine filter held two coins and a small button. Check it more often.
Picnic plan: shaded spot, cold noodles, peaches, cards, extra water for everyone.
Mi amiga prefiere que le pregunte cómo está sin intentar arreglarlo todo. Escuchar también es ayudar.
Book the skin check and mention the spot on my shoulder that has changed.
Bought a used puzzle with one piece missing. We gave the empty patch an elaborate backstory.
After work I nearly canceled dinner with my brother. Glad I went; we laughed about things I had forgotten.
Write the freezer date on the lid as well as the side. Frozen containers refuse to cooperate.
Frase para recordar: «No todo lo pendiente es urgente».
The draft under the front door is worse in the evening. Measure for a new seal.
My niece asked for a sewing lesson. Start with a felt pouch and let her choose wildly mismatched thread.
Audiobooks make folding laundry almost pleasant. Almost.
The work presentation went better when I slowed down. Silence between sentences is allowed.
Comprar una bombilla cálida para la lámpara de lectura. La blanca parece de interrogatorio.
Appointment moved to Tuesday afternoon. Bring the referral letter and the list of current medicines.
Tried making dumplings with friends. The ugly ones tasted exactly as good as the tidy ones.
For the next trip, book somewhere with a washing machine. Packing fewer clothes was worth the small extra cost.
Put the tax documents in one folder as they arrive. A shoebox is not a filing philosophy.
Antes del trabajo dejé la cena preparada. Volver y encontrarla lista fue un regalo de mi yo de la mañana.
The balcony chair needs sanding before another coat of paint. Borrow the sanding block from my brother.
Mom described her first bicycle today: red frame, enormous basket, unreliable brakes. Record the story next visit if she feels like it.
Try the beginner pottery class again. I liked the clay more than the bowl I made.
Switching to decaf after lunch seems to help my sleep. Keep noting bedtime and wake-ups for another week.
El mercado cierra antes los domingos. Ir por la mañana si quiero comprar pan.
Work was frustrating, so I baked something with clear instructions and a predictable ending.
Next year's savings goal: replace the mattress without putting it on credit.
The plant near the radiator needs a different spot. Brown tips are becoming its main feature.
Send my aunt the photo of her finished blanket. She has only seen it half knitted.
Llevar una bolsa pequeña para la ropa mojada cuando vaya a nadar.
Read a whole book on the train and barely checked the time. Choose that seat again if possible.
Scheduled the dentist before work so I cannot spend the entire day anticipating it.
The bathroom fan rattles on startup. Ask for a repair estimate before assuming it needs replacing.
My friend and I cooked from the same recipe in separate kitchens and compared results by phone. Hers looked better; mine had more cheese.
Revisar las condiciones del seguro de viaje antes de pagar. Guardar también el teléfono de asistencia.
The new walking route passes three benches. Good choice for an outing with Grandma.
Idea for rainy Sundays: invite one friend over to teach one small thing they know.
A work problem became clearer after I explained it aloud to an empty kitchen. The kettle offered no objections.
Freeze sliced ginger before it goes soft. Easier to grate that way too.
Mi sobrino ya no quiere que le lea en voz alta, pero se sienta cerca cuando estoy leyendo.
Review the automatic transfers after the rent change. Leave a little more breathing room in checking.
The optician adjusted the frames in five minutes. I had tolerated them sliding down for six months.
Keep a list of books abandoned without guilt. Sometimes the right book is simply a different book.
The last work day before the break needs a short handover note. Write it while details are still fresh.
Cambiar la junta de la cafetera. El repuesto está junto a los filtros.
My brother would rather have help assembling the shelves than another birthday object. Reserve Saturday.
Tried a silent morning without radio or podcasts. Heard the birds and, less romantically, the refrigerator.
Check whether the train ticket allows an earlier departure. Do not assume flexibility from the price.
The doctor asked me to bring home blood pressure readings. Put the notebook beside the monitor.
Hoy terminé el día con la cabeza llena. Regar las plantas me ayudó a bajar el ritmo.
Hummus experiment: reserve some chickpea liquid and blend longer. The extra minute made a difference.
Sold the unused camera lens. Put the money toward the mattress fund before it dissolves into ordinary spending.
The park concert was free, crowded, and wonderful. Bring a cushion next time.
Ask the repair shop about the toaster lever. It only stays down when given an encouraging glare.
La novela que me prestaron tiene una hoja seca entre las páginas. Preguntar si quieren conservarla.
Finished work early enough to cook with Mom. She still cuts every carrot a different size and somehow times everything perfectly.
Swimming lesson reminder: exhale underwater instead of saving everything for the turn.
My friend has a difficult appointment next week. Offer a ride and bring something easy for dinner.
A line I wrote while waiting for the bus: "A quiet day can still be a full day."
Antes de comprar regalos, revisar el cajón donde guardo los que compré durante el año.
The spare room is more useful with less furniture. Donate the little table after checking whether my sister wants it.
Work starts more easily when tomorrow's first task is already written down. Keep it specific and small.
The new mattress arrived. Saved for it, paid for it, slept like a person with no opinions.
Pick up the repaired boots on Friday. Bring the paper claim ticket.
Mi sobrina quiere aprender a hacer tortilla. Comprar huevos extra para practicar sin prisas.
Borrowed binoculars for the marsh walk. Suddenly all those distant brown dots became interesting birds.
Ask about the recurring ankle stiffness at the checkup. Write down when it happens rather than guessing later.
A busy stretch at work is coming. Arrange easy dinners and keep one evening free.
The cherry cake needs a tray underneath. Juice escaped and became a second, less edible baking project.
Guardar las medidas del hueco de la nevera antes de mirar modelos. Incluir el espacio para abrir la puerta.
My oldest friend remembered the song we played on that rainy road trip. Neither of us remembered the destination correctly.
Travel note: one planned activity each day leaves enough room for getting pleasantly lost.
The library has a seed exchange. Take the spare bean seeds in labeled envelopes.
Stopped checking work messages during the film. I followed the plot and remembered how relaxing that feels.
Comparar el gasto real de la compra con el presupuesto. Este mes hubo invitados; no sacar conclusiones de una sola semana.
The kitchen drawer slides need replacing. Measure both length and width; the last pair almost fit.
Dinner with Dad turned into a lesson on repairing punctures. Keep the little kit he gave me in the bike bag.
Read last January's worries. Some happened, many did not, and a few no longer make sense to me.
Schedule the car inspection before the reminder becomes urgent. Check the tire tread too.
Después del trabajo fui a la clase de cerámica. El cuenco sigue torcido, pero ya no se parece a un cenicero.
My sister found another recording of Grandma singing while cooking. Back it up in two places.
Try a spring pantry challenge: cook through the beans, grains, and ambitious jars before buying more.
The eye appointment is confirmed for next month. Bring both pairs of glasses.
The walking holiday needs a rest day in the middle. Enjoying the scenery is easier when my feet are not negotiating surrender.
Mi amigo devolvió el libro con una nota sobre su página favorita. Quiero empezar a hacer lo mismo.
Work was demanding this week, but Saturday stayed empty on purpose. Breakfast took an hour. I watched the rain. That was enough.
Replace the cracked hose connector before watering becomes an accidental shower again.
Renew the passport photo before submitting the application. The old spare is definitely too old now.
Wrote down three things I learned at work this month. Progress is easier to notice when it has somewhere to land.
Preparar sopa para congelar, llamar a mamá y sacar el abrigo del armario. El frío siempre parece llegar de golpe.
